The lowercase convention avoids visual noise from capitalization, making it easier to spot issues at a glance, while the square brackets serve as clear, standardized markers for different annotation types (such as `TODO`, `FIXME`, or `BUG`). This approach also allows the comments to be easily parsed programmatically by scripts or CI pipelines that look for bracketed tags, enabling automated tracking and reporting without relying on additional metadata or external tools.
